title: 1000 CNY high-conviction regime-concentrated ETF sleeve
status_context: One fixed post-discovery historical diagnostic. It may reject the challenger but cannot authorize capital.
economic_mechanism: Medium-horizon fund-flow persistence may reward concentrating a small sleeve in the strongest positive-trend liquid ETF, while absolute momentum and volatility scaling move the sleeve toward cash when the state weakens.
known_limits: The period and universe were already observed in prior research, so this is not clean forward evidence.
Present-day universe selection creates survivorship and selection bias.
Daily bars cannot prove live fills during gaps.
The entire 1000 CNY sleeve can be lost.
